upgrades.name: Composite Construction
upgrades.effect: Increase Durability by 10 or set it to 20; an additional Tech Point can make the weapon non-metal-detectable subject to ammunition.

upgrades.name: Enhanced Power Cell
upgrades.effect: Any Powered device can increase Capacity by 5.

upgrades.name: Extended Barrel
upgrades.effect: Firearms +1 against Adjacent targets, with Firearms -1 in Shared Zone.

upgrades.name: Extended Magazine
upgrades.effect: Increase solid-ammunition Capacity; very large magazines can remove Defensive/Concealment.

upgrades.name: Genemapped Security
upgrades.effect: Powered functions/Use restricted to the mapped user. Hardwired.

upgrades.name: Mag-Plating
upgrades.effect: Linked one-handed/pistol weapon can be recalled to the user with the published procedure.

upgrades.name: Magazine
upgrades.effect: Attachment that supplies the weapon Capacity and grants Reload; spare magazines occupy cargo space.

upgrades.name: Scope
upgrades.effect: Aim while Deployed grants Firearms +1 against Shared Zone targets.

upgrades.name: Scope, Longshot
upgrades.effect: Aim while Deployed grants Firearms +1 against Adjacent targets and ignores one Distant Zone for Difficulty.

upgrades.name: Scope, Sniper
upgrades.effect: Long-range Aim/Rangefinder package; Linked optics improve bonuses and ignored Distant Zones.

upgrades.name: Sight, Laser
upgrades.effect: Powered Gear Bonus +1 to relevant Pistol/Small Arms Firearms checks in Shared Zone.

upgrades.name: Stock, Folding
upgrades.effect: Deployed Small Arms gain the published Firearms bonus, increase size, and require both hands.
